answer: Weight accrues only after a newcomer finishes a sequential computation that climbs to a zenith of 1,000,000,000 steps, about one hour of wall-clock time that cannot be split across machines, so each fake costs its own full hour. The finished proof then waits through a 24-hour raven flight to the ledger, and each valid key is pressed into shale once; a key pressed a second time voids both accounts and all their accumulated weight.
